Market value EUR 4.3m per fotmob though footballtransfers.com ETV was higher (EUR 5.1-6.9m) - range noted. The 27 apps/7 goals figure (Wikipedia) and the 613-minute/2-goal/1-assist figure (fotmob, same 2026 season) appear to be from different snapshot dates within the same season; both are reported (apps/goals from Wikipedia as the fuller-season figure, minutes/assists from fotmob) rather than silently reconciled - treat as approximate.
